newsitem.title: USA: Jos. A Bank Q2 sales climb 17.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jos. A Bank Q2 sales climb 17.1 pct.

text.p: Jos. A. Bank Clothiers Inc said Wednesday that total sales for the second quarter, ended August 2, increased 17.1 percent, to $39.5 million, compared with $33.8 million in the 1996 quarter.
Total sales for the first six months of fiscal 1997 increased 9.9 percent, to $78.2 million, compared with $71.1 million in the year-earlier period.
Comparable store sales increased 10.8 percent in the quarter and 4.3 percent for the six months.

The company said it opened new stores in Woodbury, N.Y. and Monmouth, N.J. in the second quarter, and will open between six to eight stores in existing markets, including New York, Georgia, Colorado, Maryland and Texas, in the second half of 1997.

The company added that it has signed a commitment letter with its primary lender that provides an additional $4 million to finance the opening of new stores and extended the bank's commitment from 1999 to the year 2001.
